stage_policy: Reuse the reference release-time grid, deadlines and the fixed model/accuracy/board/heat/frequency controls from the immutable base.
basis: Original 250-period service block; reverse the four states, retaining dwell by state name. Preselect 3 s/2 s alternation by state-index parity as the only dwell change. Use the original ambient endpoints and their arithmetic midpoint.
design: Full factorial 2 orders x 2 dwell rules x 3 ambient values = 12; forward+flat at 25 and 30 C are regression controls from the baseline, not new cases. All instances have 125 requests per application and 500 total.
pairing: Each same-dwell order pair has identical per-scene frame counts, canonical frame/app job IDs, per-app image-rank sequence, relative deadline and total service/evaluation times. Absolute releases and absolute deadlines change with order. Within each condition every method shares exactly the same request IDs and releases.
image_stream: For each app's kth chronological invocation (counting from zero), image rank = 1+k%2. Preserve the per-app image stream on order reversal. Stable job IDs label the scene-local frame, so an individual ID need not see the same image after reordering; the synthetic duration is image-independent.
